name: Mouri Kogorou
source:
Private eye of the Mouri Detective Agency and father of Ran. Gained fame as the "Sleeping Kogorou" that deduces in an apparent state of sleep, but this is actually Conan's doing. Still remains unaware of its source.

Taken from the game's character profile.
